prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a rear-end collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1464; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm has been retained to represent the interests of our client in connection with a rear-end collision in which our client was injured. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person.

We ask that you provide the full liability policy limits applicable to the insured driver, along with a copy of the declarations page and any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply. Please also confirm the claim number assigned to this matter so that we can reference it in future correspondence.

We further request that your company preserve all evidence relating to the incident. This includes photographs, dash camera or telematics data, vehicle event data recorder information, witness statements, adjuster notes, recorded statements, repair estimates, and any other documents or electronically stored information in your possession or control. Please ensure that no such materials are altered, discarded, or destroyed while this claim is pending.

Please acknowledge receipt of this letter in writing within fourteen days.
